global_posture_summary.text: Third consecutive week of complete analytical pipeline breakdown. All regional synthesis desks report inability to conduct cross-country analysis due to continued absence of country-level weekly intelligence inputs. This represents a systematic failure of the intelligence collection infrastructure rather than a geopolitically quiet period. No assessment of global strategic developments, cross-regional dynamics, or structural shifts is possible without foundational country desk reporting. The analytical blind period now spans three weeks.

watchlist.item: Restoration of country desk analytical pipeline
watchlist.why_it_matters: Third consecutive week of system-wide analytical failure. Extended blind period creates strategic vulnerability and prevents identification of emerging global patterns.
watchlist.trigger: Receipt of country desk reports enabling regional synthesis

items_considered_rejected.reason_rejected: Complete absence of country desk inputs across all five regions prevents identification of cross-regional patterns, structural shifts, or interaction effects. Cannot conduct global-level analysis without regional synthesis inputs, which cannot be produced without country-level intelligence. This is a collection failure, not a strategic development.

Cannot identify cross-regional patterns without regional desk inputs. All five regional reports indicate inability to conduct analysis due to missing country-level weekly assessments. Executive briefing requires cross-regional evidence that does not exist this week.
